{{Top|leg|title=Gilad Halsek's ''Lambda''-class shuttle}}
{{Conjecture|legends}}
[[Gilad Halsek]] maintained a personal '''''Lambda''-class shuttle''' in his post as the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Consul-General|consul-general]] of the [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] colony [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Kothlis/Legends|Kothlis]]. [[Hangar/Legends|Docking Berth]] 120 at the [[Kothlis Starport]] was specially reserved for Halsek's [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|shuttle]].
